invariant.subject: leap
invariant.source: Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) is based on International Atomic Time (TAI), but it is adjusted by leap seconds
invariant.relation: Why atomic time and civil time diverge

candidates: The story is about the relationship between International Atomic Time (TAI) and Coordinated Universal Time (UTC): UTC is based on TAI, but leap-second adjustments mean the two are not identical. The reader should understand that civil time is connected to atomic time while also being adjusted through leap seconds.
- **Development:** Explain their supported relationship: UTC is based on TAI and is adjusted by leap seconds.
- **Context:** Introduce UTC and TAI as the two time standards at the center of the story.
